summary: Deforms and animates source geometry from input 0 along the surface of path geometry from input 1.

key_params.name: fillpath
key_params.note: Scale the source to fill the path extents.

key_params.name: keepproportions
key_params.note: Preserve proportions while fitting along the path.

common_gotchas: Input order matters: input 0 is the source geometry and input 1 is the path surface.
`fillpath` can intentionally change proportions unless `keepproportions` is used.
Path-space translate/rotate/scale values do not behave like a simple object transform on the original geometry.
key_concepts: Creep SOP deforms source geometry from input 0 along the path surface or curve from input 1.
`reset` and `resetmethod` define the initial creep transform state before animation or offsets are applied.
`fillpath` stretches or shrinks the source to the path extents, while `keepproportions` reduces distortion.
Translate values map into the path coordinate space, with X/Y/Z corresponding to U/V/W elevation behavior.
